svg.title: SC-1 Outrider floor layout test 4

g.text: Not selected: metal conduits, only breaks show

svg.text: Floor layout test 4
SC-1 Outrider · test 3 with these changes
Shields moved to the bridge's port
front corner, so Piloting, Weapons and
Shields all face forward.
Each system is a terminal against its
room's wall: a pale desk that blends
into the floor, with a small symbol on
its screen in the ship's blue.
The ship is drawn twice. Selected
(left): the conduits glow. Not
selected (right): the conduits are
metal set into the floor and blend in;
only the broken runs show, with
sparks.
Conduit wheel as in test 3: no single
cut unpowers a system, two cuts lose
at most 3, and it takes 4 to lose them
all.
Weapon hardpoints (the shoulder
mounts) are each fed twice from the
rim, so no single cut drops a weapon.
